  For Immediate Release—September 25th, 2026



        South Carolina Public Service Commission Schedules Hearing in
        Duke Energy Competitive Procurement of Solar and Co-Located
                   Storage Docket (Docket No. 2026-231-E)


  Columbia, South Carolina—The Public Service Commission of South Carolina has scheduled a hearing in
  Docket No. 2026-231-E, pertaining to Duke Energy Carolinas, LLC’s and Duke Energy Progress, LLC’s
  (collectively, “the Companies”) application for approval of 2025 Competitive Procurement of Solar and Co-
  Located Storage Programs pursuant to S.C. Code Ann. Section 58-42-20(G).

  In their application, the Companies request, in part, that the Commission issue an Order stating that:

            • The Companies’ 2025 CPRE Program complies with S.C. Code Ann. Sections 58-42-10(A) and 58-42-
            20(G);
            • The 2025 CPRE Program solicitation issued in August 2025, resulted in a fair, open, transparent, and
            non-discriminatory procurement; and
            • The Companies are permitted to recover costs incurred through the 2025 CPRE Program as provided
            for in Act 41 of 2025.

  The hearing in this matter will take place on Tuesday, February 2nd, 2027, at 10:00 a.m. This hearing will be
  broadcast live at this link and will be archived in the Docket at this link.

  For more information about this matter, including details on the Company’s request and ways members of the
  public can participate, please consult the Notice of Filing and Public Hearing at this link.

  For more information, email contact@psc.sc.gov, or call 803.896.5100. You can also follow the Commission on
  Facebook, LinkedIn, Nextdoor, and Instagram.
